_README: ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO PLAYS. A generic set in the plays-file shape, so the offline demo can run. These are not any deployment's live plays and not a recommendation: plays differ completely between organizations, which is why their criteria are free text judged by the model rather than options chosen from a list. Write your own with the play-builder skill; the guidance for every field is in skills/play-builder/references/play-fields.md. This set happens to use the 2x2-plus-override shape described in references/plays.md, because it is easy to follow, not because plays must take that shape.

plays.label: First GTM hire
plays.entry_criteria: The company has nobody in a dedicated go-to-market role today (the free people search by organization id finds no sales, marketing operations or revenue operations staff), and it has an open posting for its first go-to-market leader or first dedicated GTM hire.
plays.evidence_to_check: Free people search by organization id against GTM and RevOps titles, read by title AND by seniority; the job posting itself for scope and seniority.
plays.exit_criteria: The posting is filled or withdrawn, or someone joins in a GTM role.
plays.persona: The founder or CEO running the search.
plays.angle: They are about to hand pipeline to one person; the question is what that person inherits.

custom.label: GTM Jobs w/ URL
custom.purpose: One line per open GTM role: role | URL | posted date. The opener's reference beat cites it.

custom.label: JD Summary
custom.purpose: What the posting says the hire will own, in two sentences, from the posting text only.

scheduled_tasks: Weekly: re-check the posting; if it has closed, re-assign the play rather than keep sending.

plays.label: Founder direct
plays.entry_criteria: The company raised recently and still has nobody in a dedicated go-to-market role, and it is not hiring one: the founders are still doing the selling themselves.
plays.evidence_to_check: The funding round and its date from enrichment; free people search for GTM staff; the careers page or postings search showing no open GTM roles.
plays.exit_criteria: A GTM role is posted (move to the first-hire play) or someone joins in a GTM role.
plays.angle: Proof before headcount: what a founder-led pipeline looks like before the first hire.

plays.label: Team expansion
plays.entry_criteria: At least one person already works in a dedicated go-to-market role, and the company is hiring more go-to-market roles on top of them.
plays.evidence_to_check: Free people search for existing GTM staff and their start dates; open GTM postings.
plays.exit_criteria: The postings close, or the existing GTM lead turns out to be new in seat (the new-leader play takes over).
plays.persona: A member of the existing GTM team.
plays.angle: The team is growing faster than its process; what breaks at the next hire.

plays.label: New leader
plays.entry_criteria: Someone joined the company in a go-to-market leadership seat within roughly the last nine months. When this is true it takes precedence over the team plays, because a new leader's first months are a different conversation from a team's expansion.
plays.evidence_to_check: Free people search for GTM leaders and their start dates; a job change on their profile.
plays.exit_criteria: The leader has been in seat long enough that the first-months framing no longer holds.
plays.angle: What they are expected to have fixed by the end of their first quarter.
